findings.body: In AgentSession.recordRoutingOutcome(), when outcome.status === "rejected" and outcome.safeToContinue === true, this.agent.abort() is executed synchronously on line 1328 to halt the current agent execution turn. It then launches an asynchronous unhandled closure performEscalationModelSwap(). Inside performEscalationModelSwap(), if resolveModelPool() returns undefined, if pool.tiers[targetTier] is missing, or if targetModel is not found in this.#modelRegistry.getAvailable(), the function exits early without calling this.#scheduleAgentContinue(). As a result, the agent is left in a permanently aborted/halted state without execution resumption or error propagation. Furthermore, any unhandled rejection inside performEscalationModelSwap() is caught only by console.error, also leaving the agent permanently halted.
findings.recommendation: Validate and resolve targetModel before invoking this.agent.abort() in recordRoutingOutcome(). If targetModel cannot be resolved or is not available in modelRegistry, avoid aborting the active agent turn or guarantee execution resumption in a try-finally block.
findings.title: Unhandled agent abort and missing execution resumption when escalation model swap fails or target model is unavailable
